shared_elements: a bird-like form in profile (in A, a bird hieroglyph; in B, no bird — only animals)
justification: A shows an inscription-like field of repeated abstract signs enclosed in an oval cartouche with a small profile bird and disc inside, while B shows a narrative procession of human figures leading horned rams beside a stylised tree. Beyond both being shallow relief with a horizontal register and some profile creature, there is no shared motif, no shared relationship (enclosure of signs vs. men leading animals), and quite different conventions (schematic sign repertoire vs. naturalistic patterned animals).
